name: 02c_direct_lift
title: Direct two-robot lift
subtitle: Both G1s stoop on the same side, slide their hands under the patient, lift to knee height, roll the patient to their chests, side-step to the cot and set the patient down.

captions.text: Direct ground lift: both G1s work from the same side. A takes the shoulders and lower back, B the hips and knees.
They stoop and slide their hands under the body, palms up.
On the count, both lift to knee height together.
They roll the patient toward their chests and stand. Holding the load close cuts the torque at the hips.
They side-step together to the cot, in step.
They lower the patient onto the cot and let them roll flat.
